parsed.rationale: All three records — `SheetDraggingKey` in `WXUI/OverlaySheet.swift`, `ThemePickerActiveKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift`, and `UITestingModeKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift` — are empty-body `type-alias-object` kinds whose structural identity (`shared_field_count: 1`, `fields_or_signature: []`) is entirely explained by the SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey` boilerplate pattern, not by shared domain logic. Each key encodes a distinct, unrelated concern (sheet drag state, theme picker activation, UI-testing mode), so extracting them to a common location would couple unrelated subsystems without eliminating any real duplication. The coincidence is purely structural.
